title: Prompt-blind visual observation
description: One image, observed without the person's aesthetic vocabulary anywhere in the request. Sent to llama-server as response_format.json_schema with strict:true, so it is a GRAMMAR the sampler is constrained by and not a request the model may decline. `status` is a one-value enum on purpose: a model cannot mark an appearance `measured` here, because the token is not in the grammar. The prose is audited separately, since a field can say `interpretive` while the sentence beside it says `approximately thirty degrees`.

image_ref.description: Echoed back from the reference the caller supplied. The tokens are opaque (img-k7, img-q2, img-v9) so a returned ref is either one that was handed over or it is invented — an ordinal like A/B/C could be guessed correctly by a model that tracked nothing.

locus.description: Where in the frame this entry is about. A feature or a region, in the model's own words.

visible_organization.description: How what is there is arranged. Not what it means.

surface_light_behavior.description: What the light does on that surface.

apparent_material_effect.description: What material effect the appearance suggests. APPARENT: this is an inference from a photograph, never a material identification.

uncertainty.description: The model's own confidence in this entry. Recorded, and never promoted into evidence by anything downstream.

status.description: The only permitted value. Nothing observed by a VLM is measured; a measuring capability has not run. The single-value enum is the enforcement, not the description.

cannot_determine.description: What this photograph cannot settle. An empty array is a claim that everything asked was determinable, and is read as one.
